the id the console shows.\"\"\"\n\n    def _find(c: TestClient, email: str) -> int:\n        match = re.search(ACCOUNT_ROW.format(email=re.escape(email)),\n                          c.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text)\n        assert match, f\"No account row for {email}\"\n        return int(match.group(1))\n\n    return _find\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef new_account(client_as, post_form):\n    \"\"\"Return a helper: new_account(email, password, role) creates it as the admin.\n\n    Goes through the admin's account-management route, like the Coach would.\n    \"\"\"\n    admin = None\n\n    def _create(email: str, password: str, role: Role = Role.EDITOR) -> None:\n        nonlocal admin\n        admin = admin or client_as(\"admin\")\n        response = post_form(admin, \"/admin/accounts\", email=email,\n                             password=password, role=role)\n        assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n\n    return _create\n=== tests/test_t02_accounts.py\n\"\"\"T02: the Coach manages accounts (issue #3).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom conftest import DEMO_ACCOUNTS\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nADMIN_EMAIL = DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"admin\"][\"email\"]\nEDITOR_EMAIL = DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"editor\"][\"email\"]\n\n\ndef can_log_in(client: TestClient, csrf, email: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    response = client.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": email, \"password\": password,\n                                           \"csrf_token\": csrf(client, \"/login\")},\n                           follow_redirects=False)\n    return response.status_code == 303\n\n\n# --- creating accounts -------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_creates_an_editor_who_can_then_log_in(\n        client_as, post_form, client, csrf):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = post_form(admin, \"/admin/accounts\", email=\"manager@example.test\",\n                       password=\"team-manager-pw\", role=\"editor\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/accounts\"\n    listing = admin.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n    assert \"manager@example.test\" in listing\n    assert can_log_in(client, csrf, \"manager@example.test\", \"team-manager-pw\")\n\n\ndef test_admin_creates_another_admin(client_as, client, csrf, post_form):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    post_form(admin, \"/admin/accounts\", email=\"webmaster@example.test\",\n            password=\"webmaster-pw\", role=\"admin\")\n    assert can_log_in(client, csrf, \"webmaster@example.test\", \"webmaster-pw\")\n    assert client.get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_creating_an_account_with_a_taken_email_is_refused(client_as, post_form):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = post_form(admin, \"/admin/accounts\", email=EDITOR_EMAIL.upper(),\n                       password=\"another-password\", role=\"editor\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"already has an account\" in response.text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"fields, message\", [\n    ({\"email\": \"x@example.test\", \"password\": \"short\", \"role\": \"editor\"},\n     \"at least 8 characters\"),\n    ({\"email\": \"\", \"password\": \"long-enough-pw\", \"role\": \"editor\"},\n     \"Enter an email\"),\n    ({\"email\": \"x@example.test\", \"password\": \"long-enough-pw\", \"role\": \"owner\"},\n     \"Choose a role\"),\n])\ndef test_invalid_new_account_is_refused_and_the_form_keeps_the_email(\n        client_as, post_form, fields, message):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = post_form(admin, \"/admin/accounts\", **fields)\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert message in response.text\n    if fields[\"email\"]:\n        assert fields[\"email\"] in response.text\n    assert fields[\"password\"] not in response.text\n\n\n# --- changing roles ----------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_admin_changes_an_editors_role_to_admin(client_as, post_form, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    response = post_form(admin, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/role\", role=\"admin\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_admin_cannot_change_their_own_role(client_as, post_form, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    me = account_id(admin, ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    response = post_form(admin, f\"/admin/accounts/{me}/role\", role=\"editor\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert admin.get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_changing_to_an_unknown_role_is_refused(client_as, post_form, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    response = post_form(admin, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/role\", role=\"owner\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n\n\n# --- deactivating and reactivating -------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_deactivate_then_reactivate(client_as, post_form, client, csrf, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    password = DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"editor\"][\"password\"]\n\n    assert post_form(admin, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/active\",\n                   active=\"0\").status_code == 303\n    assert not can_log_in(client, csrf, EDITOR_EMAIL, password)\n    assert \"Deactivated\" in admin.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n\n    assert post_form(admin, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/active\",\n                   active=\"1\").status_code == 303\n    assert can_log_in(client, csrf, EDITOR_EMAIL, password)\n\n\ndef test_admin_cannot_deactivate_their_own_account(client_as, post_form, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    me = account_id(admin, ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    response = post_form(admin, f\"/admin/accounts/{me}/active\", active=\"0\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"your own account\" in response.text\n    assert admin.get(\"/admin\").status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_unknown_account_is_404(client_as, post_form):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert post_form(admin, \"/admin/accounts/999/active\",\n                   active=\"0\").status_code == 404\n    assert post_form(admin, \"/admin/accounts/999/role\",\n                   role=\"editor\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef test_accounts_cannot_be_deleted(client_as, post_form, account_id):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    response = post_form(admin, f\"/admin/accounts/{target}/delete\")\n    assert response.status_code in (404, 405)\n    assert EDITOR_EMAIL in admin.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n\n\n# --- the permission matrix ---------------------------------------------------\n\nACCOUNT_ROUTES = [\n    (\"get\", \"/admin/accounts\", {}),\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/accounts\",\n     {\"email\": \"sneaky@example.test\", \"password\": \"sneaky-pw\", \"role\": \"admin\"}),\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/accounts/{admin_id}/role\", {\"role\": \"editor\"}),\n    (\"post\", \"/admin/accounts/{admin_id}/active\", {\"active\": \"0\"}),\n]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"method, path, data\", ACCOUNT_ROUTES)\ndef test_editor_is_refused_every_account_route(\n        client_as, post_form, client, csrf, account_id, method, path, data):\n    admin_id = account_id(client_as(\"admin\"), ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    url = path.format(admin_id=admin_id)\n    if method == \"get\":\n        response = editor.get(url, follow_redirects=False)\n    else:\n        response = post_form(editor, url, **data)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    # Nothing changed: the admin can still log in and manage accounts, and the\n    # sneaky account was not created.\n    assert can_log_in(client, csrf, ADMIN_EMAIL, DEMO_ACCOUNTS[\"admin\"][\"password\"])\n    assert client.get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 200\n    assert \"sneaky@example.test\" not in client.get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"method, path, data\", ACCOUNT_ROUTES)\ndef test_anyone_not_logged_in_is_sent_to_login(client, method, path, data):\n    url = path.format(admin_id=1)\n    response = getattr(client, method)(url, follow_redirects=False,\n                                       **({\"data\": data} if data else {}))\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"/admin/accounts\", \"/admin/accounts/1/role\",\n                                  \"/admin/accounts/1/active\"])\ndef test_account_forms_without_csrf_are_rejected(client_as, path):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = admin.post(path, data={\"email\": \"x@example.test\", \"password\":\n                                      \"long-enough-pw\", \"role\": \"editor\",\n                                      \"active\": \"0\"}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_account_forms_carry_a_csrf_token(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin/accounts\").text\n    assert page.count('method=\"post\"') >= 3\n    assert page.count('method=\"post\"') == page.count('name=\"csrf_token\"')\n\n\n# --- the console link --------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_accounts_link_appears_only_for_admins(client_as):\n    assert 'href=\"admin/accounts\"' in client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert \"admin/accounts\" not in client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin\").text\n\n\ndef test_links_still_work_on_a_refusal_page_at_a_deeper_url(client_as, post_form,\n                                                           account_id):\n    \"\"\"A refusal re-renders the list at /admin/accounts/N/active; every link and\n    form on it must still point at a real console route.\"\"\"\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    me = account_id(admin, ADMIN_EMAIL)\n    url = f\"/admin/accounts/{me}/active\"\n    page = post_form(admin, url, active=\"0\")\n    assert page.status_code == 400\n    targets = re.findall(r'(?:href|action)=\"([^\"]+)\"', page.text)\n    resolved = {urljoin(f\"http://testserver{url}\", t) for t in targets}\n    paths = {r.removeprefix(\"http://testserver\") for r in resolved}\n    assert \"/admin\" in paths and \"/admin/accounts\" in paths\n    editor_id = account_id(admin, EDITOR_EMAIL)\n    assert f\"/admin/accounts/{editor_id}/role\" in paths\n    assert f\"/admin/accounts/{editor_id}/active\" in paths\n=== tests/test_t00.py\n\"\"\"T00: the walking skeleton. These pass in the fresh template.\n\nDo not delete them. If a change breaks them, the change broke the app's front\ndoor.\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_admin_console_answers(client_as):\n    response = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"hello admin\" in response.text.lower()\n\n\ndef test_public_home_answers(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_publish_writes_a_site(tmp_path):\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    out = render_site(tmp_path / \"site\")\n    assert (out / \"index.html\").exists() and (out / \"style.css\").exists()\n\n\ndef test_published_html_uses_relative_paths(tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Root-absolute paths break on GitHub Pages project URLs (rubric F2).\"\"\"\n    from app.publish import render_site\n\n    html = (render_site(tmp_path / \"site\") / \"index.html\").read_text()\n    assert 'href=\"/' not in html and 'src=\"/' not in html\n# ADR-002: FastAPI + Jinja + SQLite, with no frontend framework\n\n**Status:** accepted (set by the assignment)\n**Date:** 2026-09-22\n\n## Context\n\nThe project has to be readable by someone who has never built a web application,\ngradable from a clean clone, and finishable in two weeks on a $20 plan. Options\nconsidered: Django (batteries included, but a large amount of generated code to\nread), Flask (similar to FastAPI here), a JavaScript stack (a second language and\na build step), and FastAPI with server-rendered templates.\n\n## Decision\n\nFastAPI with Jinja2 templates, SQLite for storage, argon2 for password hashing,\nand an HTML sanitizer for user Markdown. No frontend framework, no build step.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- Every page is server-rendered, so \"view source\" shows what the code produced,\n  which makes debugging visible.\n- SQLite is a single file, so a grader can seed and inspect it easily. \"team-manager-pw\"}\n\n\ndef new_post(post_form, c: TestClient, title: str, body: str = \"\", **fields) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Save a draft through the console; return the id it redirects to.\"\"\"\n    response = post_form(c, \"/admin/posts\", title=title, body=body,\n                         action=\"save\", **fields)\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    match = re.fullmatch(r\"/admin/posts/(\\d+)\", response.headers[\"location\"])\n    assert match, response.headers[\"location\"]\n    return int(match.group(1))\n\n\ndef slug_of(c: TestClient, post_id: int) match.group(1)\n\n\ndef stamps(c: TestClient, post_id: int) -> dict[str, str]:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}\").text\n    return dict(re.findall(r'<time class=\"(created|updated)\" test_anyone_not_logged_in_is_sent_to_login(client, method, url):\n    response = getattr(client, method)(url, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == {"parentUuid":"3824f708-f8c1-4de9-a6f9-1a45ce54f42c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3LeN86KUBgivENijzAj","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013FBNnU2pCds7mMeZKzvY7e","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/markdown.py","content":"\"\"\"User-written Markdown -> safe HTML.\n\nEvery place that shows a post or page body (console preview, public site)\ngoes through render_markdown(), so nothing user-written reaches a browser\nunsanitized. Scripts, event handlers and javascript: links are stripped, and\nimages are not allowed at all (recaps are text only).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\n_md = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\").enable(\"table\").enable(\"strikethrough\")\n\nALLOWED_TAGS = nh3.ALLOWED_TAGS - {\"img\", \"area\", \"map\"}\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(_md.render(text), tags=ALLOWED_TAGS)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":492,"cache_read_input_tokens":74058,"output_tokens":2699,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":492,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2699,"cache_read_input_tokens":74058,"cache_creation_input_tokens":492,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":492},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_013FBNnU2pCds7mMeZKzvY7e":{"file_path":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/markdown.py","content":"\"\"\"User-written Markdown -> safe HTML.\n\nEvery place that shows a post or page body (console preview, public site)\ngoes through render_markdown(), so nothing user-written reaches a browser\nunsanitized. Scripts, event handlers and javascript: links are stripped, and\nimages are not allowed at all (recaps are text only).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\n_md = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\").enable(\"table\").enable(\"strikethrough\")\n\nALLOWED_TAGS = nh3.ALLOWED_TAGS - {\"img\", \"area\", \"map\"}\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(_md.render(text), tags=ALLOWED_TAGS)\n"}},"serverClassifierRequest":"bf7eff84-66be-4f20-b6a9-dc4e15952a13","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011Cg3LeMfKHfZXu1FrWnioe","requestRef":"13e992bf-3f32-4c38-9e73-146fdcb904fb","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:implement","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"5d6010bc-3880-4d4e-8385-9f4ebe912db6","timestamp":"2026-10-15T03:48:45.043Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"4d76fb33-67f7-426c-a6b4-e10410ba73b3","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"4012479e-c00e-4e56-a567-b9079d7df8d1","version":"2.1.300","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"5d6010bc-3880-4d4e-8385-9f4ebe912db6","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3LeN86KUBgivENijzAj","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XbJE8xqY3s6h4GAaKBETUB","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py","content":"\"\"\"Content items: posts and pages share one shape (see CONTEXT.md).\n\nAn item has a kind (post or page), a title, a unique slug, a Markdown body, a\nstatus (draft or published), an author account and created/updated\ntimestamps. The slug is generated from the title and de-duplicated\n(\"practice-schedule\", \"practice-schedule-2\", ...); only admins set one by hand.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime\nfrom enum import StrEnum\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\n\nclass Kind(StrEnum):\n    POST = \"post\"\n    PAGE = \"page\"\n\n\nclass Status(StrEnum):\n    DRAFT = \"draft\"\n    PUBLISHED = \"published\"\n\n\nclass SlugTaken(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an admin sets a slug another item already uses.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Item:\n    id: int\n    kind: Kind\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    status: Status\n    author_id: int\n    author_email: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n\ndef can_change(account: Account, item: Item) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Admins change anything; editors change only posts they wrote.\"\"\"\n    return account.is_admin or (item.kind is Kind.POST\n                                and item.author_id == account.id)\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"'Practice Schedule!' -> 'practice-schedule'; '' when nothing is left.\"\"\"\n    ascii_text = (unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text)\n                  .encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode())\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", ascii_text.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec=\"microseconds\")\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT items.*, accounts.email AS author_email\nFROM items JOIN accounts ON accounts.id = items.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _from_row(row) -> Item:\n    return Item(id=row[\"id\"], kind=Kind(row[\"kind\"]), title=row[\"title\"],\n                slug=row[\"slug\"], body=row[\"body\"], status=Status(row[\"status\"]),\n                author_id=row[\"author_id\"], author_email=row[\"author_email\"],\n                created_at=row[\"created_at\"], updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"])\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str, kind: Kind) -> str:\n    base = slugify(title) or kind.value\n    taken = {row[\"slug\"] for row in conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT slug FROM items WHERE slug = ? OR slug LIKE ?\",\n        (base, f\"{base}-%\"))}\n    slug, n = base, 2\n    while slug in taken:\n        slug, n = f\"{base}-{n}\", n + 1\n    return slug\n\n\ndef create_item(db_path: Path, kind: Kind, title: str, body: str,\n                author: Account) -> Item:\n    now = _now()\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO items (kind, title, slug, body, author_id, created_at,\"\n            \" updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (kind, title, _unique_slug(conn, title, kind), body, author.id, now,\n             now),\n        )\n    return get_item(db_path, cursor.lastrowid)\n\n\ndef get_item(db_path: Path, item_id: int) -> Item | None:\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(_SELECT + \"WHERE items.id = ?\", (item_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef list_items(db_path: Path, kind: Kind) -> list[Item]:\n    \"\"\"Newest first.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        rows = conn.execute(_SELECT + \"WHERE kind = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC,\"\n                            \" items.id DESC\", (kind,)).fetchall()\n    return [_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef update_item(db_path: Path, item_id: int, title: str, body: str,\n                slug: str | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Change title and body; change the slug too when one is given.\n\n    Raises SlugTaken if the new slug belongs to another item.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE items SET title = ?, body = ?, slug = COALESCE(?, slug),\"\n                \" updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                (title, body, slug, _now(), item_id),\n            )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\ndef delete_item(db_path: Path, item_id: int) -> None:\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM items WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":492,"cache_read_input_tokens":74058,"output_tokens":2699,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":492,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2699,"cache_read_input_tokens":74058,"cache_creation_input_tokens":492,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":492},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01XbJE8xqY3s6h4GAaKBETUB":{"file_path":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py","content":"\"\"\"Content items: posts and pages share one shape (see CONTEXT.md).\n\nAn item has a kind (post or page), a title, a unique slug, a Markdown body, a\nstatus (draft or published), an author account and created/updated\ntimestamps. The slug is generated from the title and de-duplicated\n(\"practice-schedule\", \"practice-schedule-2\", ...); only admins set one by hand.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime\nfrom enum import StrEnum\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\n\nclass Kind(StrEnum):\n    POST = \"post\"\n    PAGE = \"page\"\n\n\nclass Status(StrEnum):\n    DRAFT = \"draft\"\n    PUBLISHED = \"published\"\n\n\nclass SlugTaken(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an admin sets a slug another item already uses.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Item:\n    id: int\n    kind: Kind\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    status: Status\n    author_id: int\n    author_email: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n\ndef can_change(account: Account, item: Item) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Admins change anything; editors change only posts they wrote.\"\"\"\n    return account.is_admin or (item.kind is Kind.POST\n                                and item.author_id == account.id)\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"'Practice Schedule!' -> 'practice-schedule'; '' when nothing is left.\"\"\"\n    ascii_text = (unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text)\n                  .encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode())\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", ascii_text.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec=\"microseconds\")\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT items.*, accounts.email AS author_email\nFROM items JOIN accounts ON accounts.id = items.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _from_row(row) -> Item:\n    return Item(id=row[\"id\"], kind=Kind(row[\"kind\"]), title=row[\"title\"],\n                slug=row[\"slug\"], body=row[\"body\"], status=Status(row[\"status\"]),\n                author_id=row[\"author_id\"], author_email=row[\"author_email\"],\n                created_at=row[\"created_at\"], updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"])\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str, kind: Kind) -> str:\n    base = slugify(title) or kind.value\n    taken = {row[\"slug\"] for row in conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT slug FROM items WHERE slug = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC,\"\n                            \" items.id DESC\", (kind,)).fetchall()\n    return [_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef update_item(db_path: Path, item_id: int, title: str, body: str,\n                slug: str | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Change title and body; change the slug too when one is given.\n\n    Raises SlugTaken if the new slug belongs to another item.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE items SET title = ?, body = ?, slug = COALESCE(?, slug),\"\n                \" updated_at = ? Now the Markdown renderer and the content module."},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013FBNnU2pCds7mMeZKzvY7e","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/markdown.py","content":"\"\"\"User-written Markdown -> safe HTML.\n\nEvery place that shows a post or page body (console preview, public site)\ngoes through render_markdown(), so nothing user-written reaches a browser\nunsanitized. Scripts, event handlers and javascript: links are stripped, and\nimages are not allowed at all (recaps are text only).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n\n_md = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\").enable(\"table\").enable(\"strikethrough\")\n\nALLOWED_TAGS = nh3.ALLOWED_TAGS - {\"img\", \"area\", \"map\"}\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(_md.render(text), tags=ALLOWED_TAGS)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XbJE8xqY3s6h4GAaKBETUB","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/content.py","content":"\"\"\"Content items: posts and pages share one shape (see CONTEXT.md).\n\nAn item has a kind (post or page), a title, a unique slug, a Markdown body, a\nstatus (draft or published), an author account and created/updated\ntimestamps. The slug is generated from the title and de-duplicated\n(\"practice-schedule\", \"practice-schedule-2\", ...); only admins set one by hand.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nimport unicodedata\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime\nfrom enum import StrEnum\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.accounts import Account\n\n\nclass Kind(StrEnum):\n    POST = \"post\"\n    PAGE = \"page\"\n\n\nclass Status(StrEnum):\n    DRAFT = \"draft\"\n    PUBLISHED = \"published\"\n\n\nclass SlugTaken(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an admin sets a slug another item already uses.\"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Item:\n    id: int\n    kind: Kind\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    status: Status\n    author_id: int\n    author_email: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n\ndef can_change(account: Account, item: Item) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Admins change anything; editors change only posts they wrote.\"\"\"\n    return account.is_admin or (item.kind is Kind.POST\n                                and item.author_id == account.id)\n\n\ndef slugify(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"'Practice Schedule!' -> 'practice-schedule'; '' when nothing is left.\"\"\"\n    ascii_text = (unicodedata.normalize(\"NFKD\", text)\n                  .encode(\"ascii\", \"ignore\").decode())\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", ascii_text.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _now() -> str:\n    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec=\"microseconds\")\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT items.*, accounts.email AS author_email\nFROM items JOIN accounts ON accounts.id = items.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _from_row(row) -> Item:\n    return Item(id=row[\"id\"], kind=Kind(row[\"kind\"]), title=row[\"title\"],\n                slug=row[\"slug\"], body=row[\"body\"], status=Status(row[\"status\"]),\n                author_id=row[\"author_id\"], author_email=row[\"author_email\"],\n                created_at=row[\"created_at\"], updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"])\n\n\ndef _unique_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str, kind: Kind) -> str:\n    base = slugify(title) or kind.value\n    taken = {row[\"slug\"] for row in conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT slug FROM items WHERE slug = ? OR slug LIKE ?\",\n        (base, f\"{base}-%\"))}\n    slug, n = base, 2\n    while slug in taken:\n        slug, n = f\"{base}-{n}\", n + 1\n    return slug\n\n\ndef create_item(db_path: Path, kind: Kind, title: str, body: str,\n                author: Account) -> Item:\n    now = _now()\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        cursor = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO items (kind, title, slug, body, author_id, created_at,\"\n            \" updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (kind, title, _unique_slug(conn, title, kind), body, author.id, now,\n             now),\n        )\n    return get_item(db_path, cursor.lastrowid)\n\n\ndef get_item(db_path: Path, item_id: int) -> Item | None:\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(_SELECT + \"WHERE items.id = ?\", (item_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef list_items(db_path: Path, kind: Kind) -> list[Item]:\n    \"\"\"Newest first.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        rows = conn.execute(_SELECT + \"WHERE kind = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC,\"\n                            \" items.id DESC\", (kind,)).fetchall()\n    return [_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef update_item(db_path: Path, item_id: int, title: str, body: str,\n                slug: str | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Change title and body; change the slug too when one is given.\n\n    Raises SlugTaken if the new slug belongs to another item.\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"UPDATE items SET title = ?, body = ?, slug = COALESCE(?, slug),\"\n                \" updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                (title, body, slug, _now(), item_id),\n            )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n        raise SlugTaken(slug) from exc\n\n\ndef delete_item(db_path: Path, item_id: int) -> None:\n    with db.connect(db_path) as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM items WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_016rjSZ3ySfsDtqAW32SbJby","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/db.py","old_string":"    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1))\n);\n\"\"\"","new_string":"    active        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1))\n);\n\n-- Posts and pages share one table; kind drives navigation and permissions.\n-- Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC strings, so they sort as text.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind       TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('post', 'page')),\n    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    body       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                       CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),\n    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL\n);\n\"\"\""},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

Editors get 403 on someone else's post, whether they follow a link\nor type the URL. Only admins may set a slug by hand; an editor's slug field,\nif sent anyway, is ignored.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import content\nfrom app.accounts import Account\nfrom app.content import Item, Kind\nfrom app.markdown import render_markdown\nfrom app.web import current_account, templates, verify_csrf\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\", dependencies=[Depends(current_account)])\n\n\ndef _form(request: Request, me: Account, *, item: Item | None, title: str,\n          body: str, slug: str, error: str = \"\", preview: bool = False,\n          status_code: int = 200):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/post_form.html\",\n        {\"title\": item.title if item else \"New post\", \"account\": me,\n         \"item\": item, \"post_title\": title, \"body\": body, \"slug\": slug,\n         \"error\": error,\n         \"preview\": render_markdown(body) if preview else None},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\ndef _editable(request: Request, me: Account, post_id: int) -> Item:\n    item = content.get_item(request.app.state.db_path, post_id)\n    if item is None or item.kind is not Kind.POST:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such post.\")\n    if not content.can_change(me, item):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"You can only change your own posts.\")\n    return item\n\n\ndef _to_post(item_id: int) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/posts/{item_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef post_list(request: Request, me: Account = Depends(current_account)):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/posts.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"account\": me, \"can_change\": content.can_change,\n         \"posts\": content.list_items(request.app.state.db_path, Kind.POST)},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_post_form(request: Request, me: Account = Depends(current_account)):\n    return _form(request, me, item=None, title=\"\", body=\"\", slug=\"\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(verify_csrf)])\ndef create_post(request: Request, me: Account = Depends(current_account),\n                title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n                action: str = Form(\"save\")):\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _form(request, me, item=None, title=title, body=body, slug=\"\",\n                     preview=True)\n    if not title.strip():\n        return _form(request, me, item=None, title=title, body=body, slug=\"\",\n                     error=\"Enter a title.\", status_code=400)\n    item = content.create_item(request.app.state.db_path, Kind.POST,\n                               title.strip(), body, me)\n    return _to_post(item.id)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}\")\ndef edit_post_form(request: Request, post_id: int,\n                   me: Account = Depends(current_account)):\n    item = _editable(request, me, post_id)\n    return _form(request, me, item=item, title=item.title, body=item.body,\n                 slug=item.slug)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(verify_csrf)])\ndef update_post(request: Request, post_id: int,\n                me: Account = Depends(current_account), title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                body: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str = Form(\"\"),\n                action: str = Form(\"save\")):\n    item = _editable(request, me, post_id)\n    if not me.is_admin:\n        slug = item.slug\n    if action == \"preview\":\n        return _form(request, me, item=item, title=title, body=body, slug=slug,\n                     preview=True)\n    error = \"\"\n    new_slug = content.slugify(slug)\n    if not title.strip():\n        error = \"Enter a title.\"\n    elif not new_slug:\n        error = \"Enter a slug with at least one letter or digit.\"\n    else:\n        try:\n            content.update_item(request.app.state.db_path, item.id, title.strip(),\n                                body, new_slug if me.is_admin else None)\n        except content.SlugTaken:\n            error = f\"The slug {new_slug} is already used by another item.\"\n    if error:\n        return _form(request, me, item=item, title=title, body=body, slug=slug,\n                     error=error, status_code=400)\n    return _to_post(item.id)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/delete\", dependencies=[Depends(verify_csrf)])\ndef delete_post(request: Request, post_id: int,\n                me: Account = Depends(current_account)):\n    item = _editable(request, me, post_id)\n    content.delete_item(request.app.state.db_path, item.id)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/posts\", status_code=303)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01PCF6JoBNhQAHQhtEsV6Mw5","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/posts.html","content":"{% {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"4012479e-c00e-4e56-a567-b9079d7df8d1","hash":"433b84a3aecf39607943916c0918bb98ba5af1618c9c3323e89d64ee5d51a2cf","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_01AvRL5UAnKv96PMUgfijSmp","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:code-review"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /home/refiv/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: since HEAD (uncommitted working tree changes for T03, issue #4; spec is issue #1). Ignore notes/usage-ledger.csv and docs/transcripts/."}},"serverClassifierRequest":"d25b55ec-2a2f-45ff-bcff-2a2b3be7c77d","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011Cg3LnSWjW92gMpPqGDb3S","requestRef":"c22bd229-ae29-4f11-a972-68dd0accb728","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:implement","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"4c462f0b-ea7b-4b02-8142-f6f814394a7a","timestamp":"2026-10-15T03:50:32.882Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"4d76fb33-67f7-426c-a6b4-e10410ba73b3","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"4012479e-c00e-4e56-a567-b9079d7df8d1","version":"2.1.300","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"c482a042-7c32-4b19-93f2-afecf84e2390","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"2915d89e-bed6-4e03-915c-3321b7172c62","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /home/refiv/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: since HEAD (uncommitted working tree changes for T03, issue #4; spec is issue #1). Drafts on the public site: the ticket says \"Drafts never appear on the public site\". `test_drafts_never_reach_the_public_site` passes without proving anything, because `render_site()` in `/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/publish.py` never reads the database. That is fine for now. Note that `rel` is added automatically, so later public-site tests that look for exact `<a href=…>` text may break.\n  2. The CLAUDE.md rule is \"Published HTML uses relative paths only\". The redirects in `app/routes/posts.py` lines 46 and 120 (`\"/admin/posts/...\"`) are root-absolute. These are console redirects, not published HTML, and they match what `accounts.py` and `auth.py` already do, so they don't break the rule.\n  3. The ticket says \"an admin may edit it [the slug]\". The slug field only shows up on the edit screen, so an admin can't choose a slug when creating a post and has to save first, then edit. This is consistent with the spec, which only asks for editing, but worth checking.\n  4. The ticket says \"The editor screen has a preview of the rendered Markdown\". The preview only appears after a server round-trip with the Preview button, not live. This meets the criterion. The tests check for both buttons, which fits the spec's later \"Save draft and Publish side by side\".\n  \n  I found no wrong behaviour in the permission logic, the slug de-duplication (the LIKE pattern is safe because slugs contain only `[a-z0-9-]`), the timestamps, or the CSRF handling.\n</agent-message>"}

The helper is small and keeps the same shape as `routes/accounts.py`. |\n| Speculative generality: `Kind.PAGE` and the page branch in `can_change` | **Kept on purpose.** The spec makes posts and pages one table and one model, and T05 builds on it. |\n| `IntegrityError` is mapped to `SlugTaken` broadly | **No change.** This matches `accounts.create_account`, and `slug` is the only unique column that an update can collide on. |\n\n### Spec\n\n| Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|\n| The \"drafts never reach the public site\" test can't fail yet, because `render_site()` reads no content | **Documented.** The test's docstring now says it guards the rule until T04 starts rendering published posts. |\n| `/admin/posts` list (the unified list is T06) | **Kept** as a stopgap so posts can be reached from the console. T06 replaces it. |\n| markdown-it `table` and `strikethrough` are enabled | **Kept.** They're harmless and still go through nh3. |\n| nh3 adds `rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"` to links | **Noted** for T04's public-site tests. |\n| Admins set a slug only after the first save | **No change.** The ticket asks that an admin \"may edit\" the slug, and that's done on the edit screen. |\n| Console redirects are root-absolute | **No change.** These are console redirects, not published HTML, and they match `auth.py` and `accounts.py`. |\n\nEvery acceptance criterion is covered by `tests/test_t03_posts.py`. Full suite: **104 passed**.\nEOF\ngh issue comment 4 --body-file /tmp/claude-1000/-home-refiv-ubuncode-iphs400-mp2-cms/4012479e-c00e-4e56-a567-b9079d7df8d1/scratchpad/review.md","description":"Run T06 replaces it. |\n| markdown-it `table` and `strikethrough` are enabled | **Kept.** They're harmless and still go through nh3. |\n| nh3 adds `rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"` to links | **Noted** for T04's public-site tests. |\n| Admins set a slug only after the first save | **No change.** The ticket asks that an admin \"may edit\" the slug, and that's done on the edit screen. |\n| Console redirects are root-absolute | **No change.** These are console redirects, not published HTML, and they match `auth.py` and `accounts.py`. |\n\nEvery acceptance criterion is covered by `tests/test_t03_posts.py`. {"parentUuid":"9fc86a11-2a09-442b-a6ad-54b8c6546e12","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg3M12NmsQuWXzys2QYK2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Ticket 03 (draft posts) is built and committed to `main` as `f3c5589`, which closes #4. I haven't pushed it. The full test suite passes: 104 tests, including 37 new ones in `tests/test_t03_posts.py`.\n\n**What it does:**\n- **Writing posts:** any logged-in account can write a post with a title and a Markdown body, saved as a draft. Each post records its author and when it was created and last updated. Posts are reached from a new \"Posts\" link on the console home page.\n- **Slugs:** the slug comes from the title and is made unique (`practice-schedule`, `practice-schedule-2`, …). Changing the title later doesn't change the slug. Only admins see a slug field, and only when editing an existing post; an edited slug must still be unique. If an editor sends a slug anyway, it is ignored.\n- **Permissions:** an editor gets a 403 on anyone else's post, whether they open it, save it, preview it or delete it, even by typing the URL directly. Admins can edit and delete any post. Each check is the same one rule: admins can change anything, editors only their own posts.\n- **Preview:** the edit screen has Preview and Save draft buttons. Preview shows the rendered Markdown with scripts, event handlers, `javascript:` links and images removed, and saves nothing. It needs a button press; it isn't live.\n- **Shared table:** posts and pages share one table, so ticket 05 (pages) can build on it. I added an \"Item\" entry to `CONTEXT.md` for that shared shape. The tests prove \"own posts only\" with a second editor (the Team manager), created through the admin's account route.\n\n**Review:** I ran `/code-review`, fixed six findings and posted all of them with how each was resolved on the issue: https://github.com/RafaelFrias1/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/4#issuecomment-6184003994. Two things still open:\n- **Drafts test can't fail yet:** the site build doesn't read any content until ticket 04, so the \"drafts never reach the public site\" test passes trivially for now. Its docstring says so, and it becomes a real check once ticket 04 renders published posts.\n- **Temporary posts list:** the list at `/admin/posts` is a stopgap; ticket 06 replaces it with the single content list.\n\nThe commit also includes `notes/usage-ledger.csv` and this session's transcript in `docs/transcripts/`, the same way earlier ticket commits did."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":789,"cache_read_input_tokens":99718,"output_tokens":862,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":49},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":789,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":862,"cache_read_input_tokens":99718,"cache_creation_input_tokens":789,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":789},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"5e5a0fb6-c0b7-45d5-88e9-d26b463d5730","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011Cg3M126AiZCrVfSRQFbA4","requestRef":"292a7132-c509-4807-8b03-5b53c9c4b6af","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","type":"assistant","uuid":"bb91ef0b-9da2-4c0c-b4fc-8742e5696726","timestamp":"2026-10-15T03:53:30.423Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"medium","perTurnEffort":"medium","session_id":"4d76fb33-67f7-426c-a6b4-e10410ba73b3","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"4012479e-c00e-4e56-a567-b9079d7df8d1","version":"2.1.300","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"027d90d5-0a84-48a9-9553-32d77a970f48","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"caa8dfb7-0609-4727-a305-58f2cf9d7791","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CRpozExPp59sTvkC48yWYu","type":"tool_result","content":"  475 docs/mp2-grading-rubric_20260922.md\n  415 docs/mp2plus-grading-rubric_20261012.md\n  890 total\n# IPHS 400 — Mini-Project #2 Grading Rubric: Build a Web CMS with an AI-SWE Workflow\n\n**Course:** IPHS 400: Frontiers in AI (Fall 2026, Kenyon College) — Jon Chun\n**Project:** Mini-Project #2 — a WordPress-style Web CMS with an admin console, built with the mattpocock/skills workflow `/grill-with-docs → /to-spec → /to-tickets → /implement → /code-review`\n**Rubric version:** v1, 2026-09-22\n**Total:** 100 points = Stage 1 (15, preliminary checkpoint, credited for the tag) + Stage 2 (85, final and graded). Extra credit comes only through MP2plus (section 5).\n**Audience:** students (Part I) and the instructor's LLM-as-judge (Part II). Students see the same checklist the judge uses.\n**Repos:** students copy the public template `jon-chun/iphs400-mp2-cms-starter`; all grading artifacts stay in the private `jon-chun/iphs400-mp2-cms-starter-dev`.\n\n> **Policy.** MP2 is **graded**. The MP2 grade is a **score out of 100**, scaled to the project's **5% of the course grade**. There is no pass line.\n> Stage 1 (15 points, the `mp2-mvp` tag, Tue Sep 29, 2026, 2:40 pm) was a preliminary, ungraded checkpoint: its 15 points are credited for the tag, not graded for quality. Stage 2 (85 points, the `mp2-final` tag) is the final, graded submission.\n> The first round of final submissions (due Oct 6) was graded and returned on Oct 8. The deadline was extended to **Thu Oct 15, 2026, 2:40 pm** (no-penalty grace until **Fri Oct 16, 2:40 pm**) so you can revise after feedback. One revised `mp2-final` by Oct 15 replaces your earlier grade.\n> Extra credit is earned only through MP2plus (section 5).\n> Solo project. Every commit after the template's base commit must be authored by the student.\n\n---\n\n## Part I — The Rubric\n\n### 1. What you submit\n\n| Stage | Deadline (Eastern, EDT, UTC−4) | Tag | Email subject |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| **Stage 1 — MVP** | Preliminary checkpoint, **Tue Sep 29, 2026, 2:40 pm** (past; ungraded) | `mp2-mvp` | `IPHS400 MP2 Stage 1 — {First Last}` |\n| **Stage 2 — Full CMS** (final, graded) | **Thu Oct 15, 2026, 2:40 pm**; no-penalty grace until **Fri Oct 16, 2:40 pm** | `mp2-final` | `IPHS400 MP2 Stage 2 — {First Last}` |\n\nEmail body, both stages: repo URL, GitHub Pages URL, tag name.
